title: Well made but difficult to use in reality
text:
Well made but difficult to use in reality. I wanted to try this because I take sandwiches for lunch every day and feel bad using a ziplock bag for each one. I really wanted to like these reusable bags, but they have been hard to get used to. They are pretty big, with thick sides that don’t fold over like a plastic bag would. That, plus the airtight seal, means that it takes up a lot more space in my lunchbox. Also, I am used to eating my sandwich out of the bag, like a wrapper, but this silicon bag is too bulky to use in the same way. Last, it is annoying to wash at the end of every day.

On the plus side, the seal is very good. I wouldn’t try to use it for liquids, but it is definitely airtight.
